coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Underscore, hyphen or comb run: the characters' box (first to last character). Text tick box "/ /" or "[ ]": the three characters' box. Drawn rule: its x extent and the 10 pt above it. Drawn box: its rectangle.
how_measured: Picture pages measured in their own pixels (799x1034, 106 ppi, 0.6762 pt/px; JPEG, rules dark below 200, tick-box borders light grey, below 215), converted through each picture's placement (pdfplumber image bbox); every page looked at; overlays looked at.

third_parties: custodian (custodian tax ID, account and phone on page 4; signature, date and medallion guarantee on page 8)
signing.kind: A four-page order form of a non-traded BDC filed as pictures. The investor and a joint investor initial fourteen representations (four general, ten state-specific) and sign page 6 (form page 3); a custodian signs and stamps section 7 and the registered representative completes and signs section 8 (page 8). No acceptance block for the company.
signing.individual_and_entity: only in the form of ownership section (trust and entity name rows, page 4)
